title: analysis.opportunity.invalidated.v1
description: Transport-ready as of the Kafka transport task (docs/adr/007-shared-cross-service-contracts.md; publisher: internal/transport/kafka/producer.go). Published by analysis-engine when a previously-published opportunity (analysis.opportunity.v1) is no longer valid — its invalidation price traded through, it expired, or the structure it was based on was itself invalidated. algo-bot's analysis_client uses this to retire a Candidate it may have already started evaluating. Deliberately a separate, minimal event rather than re-publishing the full opportunity with a status flag — a consumer that only cares about invalidation should not need the full Candidate shape. This is the PAYLOAD only — wrapped inside contracts/common/event-envelope-v1.schema.json's `payload` field. No strategy is implemented yet — this contract publishes no real events today.

opportunity_id.description: Matches the id field of the analysis.opportunity.v1 event being invalidated.

strategy.description: Neutral StrategyID from the opportunity being invalidated.

reason_code.description: Machine-readable reason code (source task §30 — never free-text-only), same discipline as opportunity-v1's evidence[].code — e.g. "INVALIDATION_PRICE_TRADED_THROUGH", "EXPIRED", "STRUCTURE_INVALIDATED". Not schema-enumerated here: the fixed value set belongs to the strategy layer that will first emit this event, not to this transport contract.
